name: Sumac
summary: A bright, lemony spice ground from dried sumac berries. The go-to souring agent across Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines.
description: Sumac brings fruity acidity without the sharpness of vinegar or the floral sweetness of lemon. It's the finishing spice on fattoush, hummus, and grilled meats, and a key flavour in za'atar blends. The deep burgundy powder loses its vibrancy quickly — buy in small quantities and use within 6 months. Its tart, astringent quality makes it ideal for cutting through rich fats in dressings and marinades.
